Roof

Gable or flat, in any collection.

Both roofs share the floor plan and the finish options.

Gable roof

A 6:12 pitch in standing seam metal. The classic cottage profile.

Flat roof

A TPO membrane that runs continuously over the porch for a cleaner, modern profile.

Layout

Studio, or a home office.

Studio

Living and sleeping, a kitchen, dining, a bath with a 36 × 32 curbless shower, and a covered porch.

Home office

Open-plan office nook with a 48 inch desk on the west-wall pier. Bed and sofa are not in this layout. Adds a 20A desk circuit and data conduit from the main house. The shell stays the same.
